title: Avila Core Reuse Rule v0.1 draft
description: An SC-12.3 non-dependence claim: an authorized, signed declaration that bytes arriving on one bound input slot do not affect one step's outputs. The kernel checks authority, applicability, and expiry; it does not prove the non-dependence. A rule can only exempt a binding edge the compiled contract actually contains — never widen a result's coverage.

rule_id.description: Stable identifier the impact report's reused_under field names when this rule permits reuse.

input_slot.description: A slot the named step actually binds in the compiled workflow; the rule claims bytes arriving on this edge do not affect the step's outputs.

justification.description: Why the non-dependence holds — the claim a signer stands behind.

validation_evidence.description: Digest-bound evidence supporting the non-dependence claim. 'The files look similar' is not validation evidence.

not_after.description: RFC-3339 UTC instant after which the rule no longer applies. Expired rules fail closed — default invalidation runs.
